emily: alert from nightly audit: 76 objects in prod-snapshots missing SSE headers between 03:05-03:08 UTC.
raja: any deploys or key changes overnight?
infra-bot: PR 6021 merged by tom @ 03:00UTC updated CMK policy alias/backup-main to restrict external roles during rotation.
encops-bot: detection: PutObject without SSE exceeded threshold (72 in 3m).
emily: uploader log snippet: 
`2026-03-22T03:06:12Z ERROR uploader: kms rewrap AccessDenied; falling back to plaintext upload`
raja: fallback in prod is unacceptable. immediate actions: revert key policy, restart rewrap service, run canary rewrap.
tom: rolling back policy now, opening hotfix PR. missed cross-account role in impact checklist, my fault.
encops-bot: task ENCRYPTOPS-733 created (hotfix policy revert) assigned to tom.
emily: follow-ups: remove silent fallback in uploader, add pre-merge gate for key policy changes, add bucket-level alert for PutObject without SSE.
raja: i'll add cloudtrail query to enumerate affected principals and save list to secure ticket.
emily: meeting 10:00UTC to triage postmortem.
